data.one_liner: Configurable text scroller widget that scrolls when content overflows.
data.what_it_does: Scrolls its child widget automatically when an overflow occurs, pauses at the end, and returns to the start. It supports both horizontal and vertical scrolling directions and can be controlled programmatically using a controller.
use_when: You need to display long text in a constrained space with automatic scrolling.
You want a simple marquee-style text scroller with minimal dependencies.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based gesture scrolling or custom list view layouts.
You require platform-specific native UI components.
strengths: Configurable speed, pause durations, and animation curves.
Supports both automatic and controller-based programmatic scrolling.
weaknesses: Limited to single-child overflow scrolling rather than generic list item management.
